pcs.pc_description: receive grounded raw material in a bag from the grinding operator.
empty the contents into an iron / wooden sieve.
perform the visual inspection of the grounded raw material while passing hand through it repeatedly.
check for easily visible unwanted materials like small stones mixed in the grounded raw material.
manually remove easily visible unwanted material from the grounded raw material.
pass the grounded raw material through iron / wooden sieve repeatedly for pre-cleaning.
use the pre-cleaned grounded material through narrow graded sieve repeatedly for fine cleaning.
simultaneously check the sieved materials for unwanted materials.
collect the fine cleaned grounded raw material in a separate clean bag.
collect the unwanted / waste materials at one place in a bin.
send the cleaned grounded raw material to dough maker for further processing.
ensure proper cleaning of the grounded raw material.
prevent mixing of clean grounded raw material from the unclean grounded raw material.
